name: Dire Wolf

Traits.name: Pack Tactics
Traits.text: The dire wolf has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the dire wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The dire wolf makes two Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Fur-Bristled Lunge.

Actions.name: Bite
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

Actions.name: Fur-Bristled Lunge
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw*: DC 13, one creature within 5 feet. *Failure:* The target is pulled up to 5 feet straight toward the dire wolf, and the target has the Prone condition.
Actions.clause: Dire Wolf — with a frost-rimed hide

lore: Born in the high passes where blizzards never fully melt, this frost-rimed dire wolf stalks down to the lowlands for warm meat, dragging its prizes back to snowpack dens and the cold it cannot live without.
